condition: sns.boxplot raises UnboundLocalError for 'boxprops' when there are no groups left to draw, e.g. all the data is NaN/None, or the order values don't match any categories (such as order= used with hue but no x).
workaround: Make sure the data has non-null values and that order/hue_order match the actual category values. When switching from x to hue, use hue_order instead of order.
